post.description:
Reserve a free compute unit and schedule the background allocation playbook.

The endpoint returns quickly once the unit is reserved. The slower machine
preparation work continues in the background.

schema.title: Response Allocate Compute Units Allocate Post

460.description: No free compute unit found to match the request

500.description: The compute unit was reserved but the allocation request could not be prepared

delete.description:
Mark a compute unit for deallocation and schedule the cleanup playbook.

The endpoint validates that the unit exists and is in a state where cleanup
makes sense before queueing the background job.

404.description: The requested compute unit does not exist

409.description: The compute unit is in a state that cannot be deallocated

500.description: The deallocation request could not be prepared
